# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and managed perf ports** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia milestone m151 and ports several hot color/text paths to managed C#. It ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion and premultiply math to managed code, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11, and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m151** — Bundles the Chrome m151 engine along with upstream bug-fix merges pulled in during the preview cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **.NET 11 WASM support** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job so exception-handling regressions are caught early. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed a native resource leak** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource when constructing a subset image. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Restored legacy shader context** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced upstream. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed color and text hot paths** — Ports SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply math to managed C#, and reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans, cutting P/Invoke overhead. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Fewer per-call allocations** — Removes per-call char[4] allocations in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding. ([#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376))
- **Faster hex color parsing** — Optimizes SKColor hex parsing and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## API Surface

- **Removed an unnecessary unsafe modifier** — GRContextOptions no longer requires the unsafe modifier, simplifying consumer code that touches it. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse and makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding, reducing overhead in shaping-heavy text workloads.
